manual.ios: Tap the Share button at the bottom of Safari, then "Add to Home Screen".
manual.android: Open your browser menu, then tap "Add to Home screen".
manual.macosSafari: In Safari, choose File, then "Add to Dock".

guide.title: Install RallyHub on your device
guide.introTablet: Adds a RallyHub icon to the home screen, Dock or desktop, so staff do not have to find the link each time. Chrome and Safari are the recommended browsers.
guide.introApp: Adds a RallyHub icon to the home screen, Dock or desktop, and opens it in its own window without the browser around it.
guide.resultTablet: The device now has a RallyHub icon that opens straight to the score screen.
guide.resultApp: The device now has a RallyHub icon that opens in its own window, with no address bar.

android.menu: Tap the three dots in the top right.

ios.open: Open {{target}} in Safari. This does not work in Chrome on iOS.
ios.share: Tap the Share button, the square with the arrow.
ios.add: Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen", then "Add".

mac.result: RallyHub opens from the Dock in its own window.

desktop.addressBar: Click the install icon at the right-hand end of the address bar.
desktop.menuFallback: If it is not there, open the three dots menu, then "Cast, save and share", then "Install page as app".
desktop.result: RallyHub opens from the desktop or taskbar in its own window.
